rules.statement: When the effect of a statute is merely to limit the time within which an action may be brought and not to extinguish the right, the court will not take the statute into account unless it is specially pleaded by way of defence.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is settled law that when, as in the case of sections 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 11 of the Prescription Ordinance, the effect of the statute is merely to limit the time in which an action may be brought and not to extinguish the right, the court will not take the statute into account unless it is specially pleaded by way of defence."
